structured.answer: I left it at the default 500 ₪ a month. After 8 years the calculator says "נשאר בידיים" 68,853 ₪, against 48,000 ₪ I'd have put in. For 4 years it gives no number at all: it says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", so if I take the money out early I just pay tax, and I don't know how much I'd get.

stuck.why: There's only one number on screen, 25,725, and for a second I thought it was my answer. It sits under "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך", which is a different thing, not the fund. The orange text says there's no calculation for me.
The first screen is all text and I couldn't see a calculator. I had to guess that the "מה קורה לכסף בקרן" tab was where it was.

used: the year picker under the chart (4 and then 8)
the orange note about withdrawing before 6 years
skimmed: the bars "החזר המס הוסיף" +9,581 and "התשואה הוסיפה" +11,272
skipped: the "הכנסה חייבת בחודש", "תשואה בשנה" and "דמי ניהול בשנה" fields (left at their defaults)
the "שווה לדעת" and "מי מציע ומי מצטרף" sections
unsure_meaning: "המס לקח 0" right next to "החזר המס הוסיף": does the tax take nothing or give money back?
the dashed box "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך"
not_found: any amount for withdrawing after 4 years as self-employed
a hint about how much a self-employed person should put in each month

findings.what: The page asks me to check 4 years and then gives no number for it. The only number shown is for a securities account, which is easy to mistake for the answer.
findings.where: the result at year 4 for self-employed

findings.what: When I switched to עצמאים, the fields moved around and changed places (the return field jumped up next to the deposit).
findings.where: the calculator fields after picking עצמאים

findings.what: Clicking the tab scrolled the page by itself, a long way down.
The chart has three colours with no legend next to them. I guessed yellow is the tax refund and green is the return.
